claims.text: May be used as an adjunct for severe dysuria while the antibiotic treats the infection;
claims.quote: For patients with severe dysuria, phenazopyridine may be used as an adjunct to reduce symptoms while the antibiotics treat the underlying infection
Phenazopyridine should be used for no more than 2 days
It is contraindicated in patients with renal insufficiency
Certain medications should be avoided entirely in patients with chronic kidney disease with eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73m 2. They include nitrofurantoin and phenazopyridine.
